policy.release_success: Every required stage for the declared product capability matrix has evidence for the same artifact digest; NOT_RUN, BLOCKED, failed, error or unexplained skip cannot count as success.
policy.skip_policy: List every skip/xfail and map it to unsupported capability or an explicitly required alternative stage; do not turn missing credentials into a green release.
policy.test_failure_policy: Keep first failure and rerun evidence. Classify environment, fixture interference or product issue. An isolated rerun does not erase the full-suite failure.
policy.baseline: Record upstream/product commits, lockfiles, image digest, Linux/Python/PG/extensions, model revisions and effective config.
policy.database_isolation: One fresh PG per CI job/shard; xdist workers in upstream currently share the job DB. Tests touching global lists/schema/DDL need explicit serial groups or isolated databases. Keep upstream 3-shard/-n8 comparison separately from this Mac -n2 run.

stages.gate: Pinned dependencies and approved image build; provision local-model snapshots before offline tests. Linux target still requires validation.
0 unexpected error; client/CLI manifest skips explicitly reviewed. Coverage check is not runtime coverage.
not_run: base-to-candidate OpenAPI compatibility: no code change candidate in this task

stages.gate: 0 unresolved failures/errors; every skip/xfail explained. Use new database per shard. Pin TZ=UTC, cached model revisions and subprocess proxy environment.
stages.local_variant: scripts/tests_full_localml.sh: -n2, no shard split, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, -s; excludes two unmarked real-LLM files, Docker S3 file and one Copilot-login case. These exclusions are requirements for S6/S7 or unsupported capability decisions, not passes.
entrypoint_templates: uv run --with pytest-split pytest tests -m 'not hs_llm_mat and not hs_llm_core' --splits 3 --group <1..3> --junitxml=api.xml

stages.gate: 0 fail/error; explicitly set HINDSIGHT_TEST_ONNX_MODEL_DIR and install local-onnx if claiming CPU ONNX capability. Never substitute stub results for model quality.
entrypoint_templates: cd hindsight-system-tests && uv run pytest tests -v --junitxml=system.xml

stages.when: every supported SDK/UI change and release
stages.gate: Build and unit tests pass; published SDK runtime suite must run against the release candidate test endpoint. Browser smoke verifies login, bank creation, retain/recall and task status. No localhost production endpoint defaults.
not_run: all Python/TS SDK real-provider integration tests

stages.when: every cloud wrapper/auth/queue change and release
stages.gate: Cross-tenant accesses all denied; invalid/revoked keys denied; no body/header tenant spoofing; pending operations survive API/Worker restarts; deletion contract and quota accounting verified. Gateway prototype passing is not production IAM passing.
local_evidence: Parent task gateway and split-worker probe artifacts
planned_checks: Run product-owned tenant/auth/Bank-ACL/idempotency/quota/delete/worker-restart tests against candidate gateway+API+Worker+PG

stages.gate: Credentials/model/client missing => BLOCKED, not green skip. Define and approve quality/cost/latency thresholds from measured baseline; report repetitions and retrieval-vs-reasoning failures separately.
local_evidence: Parent client agent real-client probe artifacts; this agent did not repeat paid LLM calls
planned_checks: Run hindsight-system-evals with pinned corpus, provider and independent judge
Run real Claude/Codex/Hermes/OpenClaw sessions on fresh isolated client homes and release candidate endpoint

stages.gate: Same artifact digest passes all required stages. Accepted operations/data meet stated RPO. Local pg0 default fsync-off restart evidence cannot prove power-loss durability. OBS/S3 compatibility requires actual service verification.
planned_checks: Generate OpenAPI/SDK/docs and verify no unexpected diff
Run restore, schema migration, rollback and claimed RPO/RTO fault tests on production-equivalent RDS/OBS
Run production-equivalent load/soak and cost-budget tests

command_semantics: Stage entrypoint_templates are documented upstream entrypoints requiring cwd/input/secrets from tests-ci-runbook.md, not claims of execution. English descriptions are planned_checks. Exact executed argv/cwd/exit/time live only in evidence/*/command.json.
